title: fix(runtime): the environment-membership check judges the principal the request resolved
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1zG3Xn4JonaKvDLLr5gnjL)_

Refs #28284

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：多环境主机上，dispatcher 的环境成员检查(`403 PROJECT_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED`)现在判断的是请求解析出的主体。由 API key 或 OAuth access token 接纳的主体，按 key 的所有者或 token 的用户判断(同时带了别人 cookie 也一样)，平台组织豁免使用解析时核验过的组织。由 session cookie 接纳的主体，判断方式与原来完全相同。
- **为什么改**：QA 第三轮发现的安全加固(细节按披露裁决不公开)
- **风险与回滚**：只改 `@objectstack/runtime`(patch)。单环境主机，以及关闭了该检查的主机(`api.enforceProjectMembership: false`)不受影响。会被新拒绝的只有：多环境主机上，以 API key 或 OAuth token 访问某环境作用域路由、但不是该环境成员的调用方。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts` 的 `enforceProjectMembership`，session 读取之后按 `admittingCredentialKind` 新增的分支；以及新文件 `packages/runtime/src/security/admitting-credential.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/http-dispatcher-membership-resolved-principal.test.ts`，预期 8/8。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位做 contract review 后落地。

## What changes

- **New `admittingCredentialKind(request)`** (`packages/runtime/src/security/admitting-credential.ts`) is the one reading of which credential admitted a request's caller.
  - It answers `oauth` when the resolved context carries OAuth scopes.
  - Otherwise it answers what the identity step's admission recorded: `api_key` or `session`.
  - It answers `undefined` when nothing was recorded.
  - `apiForwardCredentialKind` (action execution) now delegates to it, so the api-action forward and the membership check cannot disagree.
- **`HttpDispatcher.enforceProjectMembership`**: when that reading is `api_key` or `oauth`, the check judges the principal `resolveRequestScope` resolved.
  - That principal is `executionContext.userId`: the key's owner or the token's user. This holds even when a session cookie for another user rides beside it.
  - The platform-organization bypass reads `executionContext.tenantId`, the organization the resolution vetted.
- **A session-admitted principal** keeps today's path exactly: the check's own session read, the session's active organization, and the fail-open when that read throws.
- **Unchanged:**
  - hosts without environment scoping (no `kernel-resolver`, so no `environmentId`);
  - hosts that turn the check off;
  - the control-plane, share-link, approval-action and inbound-hook exemptions.

## Why

QA 第三轮发现的安全加固(细节按披露裁决不公开)

## Verification

Readings on head `44a099f05`: two commits on `main` at `c2bc76e3e`. The second answers the contract review: one shared credential reader, and a pin on a scoped data route.

<details><summary>Pins, red-first and restore</summary>

- New `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher-membership-resolved-principal.test.ts` (8): a multi-tenant host with a stub resolver and `sys_environment_member`, driven through `dispatch()`.
  - These are refused, and the refusal names the judged user:
    - a non-member admitted by an OAuth access token on `/mcp`;
    - the same token sent beside a member's cookie;
    - a non-member admitted by an API key on `/mcp`;
    - a non-member admitted by an API key on the scoped data route `/data/task`.
  - CONTROLs:
    - A cookie non-member is refused as before.
    - A member admitted by a token passes. So does a member admitted by a key. Each makes one membership read for that user.
    - A request with no credential is not judged here.
- Red-first: with `http-dispatcher.ts` set back to its `main` blob, the file read 6 failed | 2 passed (8).
  - The four refusal cases failed.
  - The two member CONTROLs failed only because no membership read was made.
  - The cookie and no-credential CONTROLs stayed green.
- Restored (blob equal to HEAD): 8 passed (8).

</details>

<details><summary>Package suite and typecheck</summary>

- `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/runtime`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` under the verify lock: Test Files 556 passed (556), Tests 8965 passed | 19 skipped (8984), `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
  - An earlier cut of this change judged any resolved principal that differed from the check's own session read. This suite's `domains/meta-read-principal-filtering.measurement.test.ts` caught it, because the two reads can disagree for a session principal.
  - The arm is now keyed on the admitting credential, and that file is green.
  - The action-execution forward tests are green on the shared reader.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` derives 69 families on this diff. Every one ran and exited 0; `check:type-check-debt` ran under the verify lock.
- `--ran` reconciliation: 69 derived, 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the changed source files: exit 0.

</details>

Not measured:
- An end-to-end multi-environment boot. No `kernel-resolver` ships in this repository, so the pins drive `dispatch()` with a stub resolver.
- The dogfood battery. Its single-environment boots set no `environmentId`, so they never reach this check.
